_readme: Team roster for team.html and the home page 'Meet the Dotfit Team' preview.
Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/build_team.py
Every name below is a bracketed placeholder — [Trainer Name] — on purpose.
This project has no source of real staff names, so nothing here should
read as a real person. Replace each [Trainer Name] with the actual staff
member, write their real bio, and swap the photo path for a real photo
photo path is deliberately named for the role (team-floor-manager.jpg,
team-head-trainer.jpg, ...) per the brief's naming convention, so it's
obvious which file to drop in. Until that file exists, the card shows
the brand dot pattern instead of a broken image.
featured: true puts this person in the home page preview (keep it to
specialization is optional — omit the field entirely for a role that
doesn't need one, rather than leaving it empty.
